Vote-state limit finding (not inline): handled in #6033's e7e07c3207, merged here in 1eb5f2721e. `count` is now documented as the Drive limit for one request (0 sends no limit and gets the node's default page), `request_limit` refuses values above `u16::MAX` instead of wrapping, and the FFI no longer trims rows (https://github.com/dashpay/platform/pull/6033#discussion_r4653386332). Paging through more than one page is not added. Separate follow-up, not in this PR: KotlinExampleApp's contest screen sums one page of contenders as "Total Votes".

_🤖 Addressed by [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)_
